# DataQA

> Analytics data reconciliation service for agencies and online stores. We compare CRM or store backend data with GA4, ad platforms, data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), dashboards (Looker Studio, Power BI, Metabase) and on-site tracking (Google Tag Manager, pixels, in-house trackers) record by record, and report lost orders, duplicate purchases, missing traffic sources, broken warehouse loads and tracking errors.

## Services and prices (USD)

- Data audit: one-off reconciliation of a whole project, $100–600 depending on data volume and number of systems. Deliverables: PDF report with a data quality score and recommendations, spreadsheet of lost and duplicate records, normalized tables with personal data hashed.
- Ongoing monitoring: scheduled re-checks with a change log; $20 per month per report or dashboard, or $150 per month for a whole project.
- Custom work: e.g. validating a new tracker against GA4, setting up scheduled checks on the client's servers. Priced on request.

## What we find

- Orders and leads that never reached analytics or the CRM, and where they are lost (web vs app, page, traffic source)
- Duplicate purchase events and duplicate warehouse loads
- Paid clicks (gclid, fbclid) recorded as direct traffic; payment providers shown as referral sources
- Days and rows dropped between warehouse layers; dashboard numbers that don't match source data
- Double page_view, tags firing before cookie consent, personal data sent to analytics

## Data handling

- Read-only access with least privilege; exports accepted instead of access
- Emails and phone numbers are hashed before analysis; reports contain no personal data
- Raw exports deleted after the engagement; NDA and DPA available
